2228-4279-6559.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-6559.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-6559.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1339-1808-4247-6625.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

413-3197-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

5641-6854-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5641-6854-7804.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

2073-4050-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

412-997-3081-3817.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

997-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

423-433-1437-3861--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-3861--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3094-4659-5390-6791-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5390-6791-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

252-1575-4659-5776.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Repeat.

1987-4125-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-4125-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Shipwreck Dowser.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3671-4365.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2281-5147-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

618-2438-4783.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2366-4178-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4178-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

250-779-1315-1479-2907.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-2907.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

969-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

1456-2854-3200-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1456-2854-3200-4574.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

67-1676-5670-5870-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-5870-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Guide of Souls and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Guide of Souls triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life and get that much {E}.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-5870-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

3767-3918-4002-5396.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3767-3918-4002-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-2178-3661-6797.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-6797.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1061-6633.easyPrerequisites: You control at least nine permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-6633.description:
Activate The Fire Crystal by paying {4}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token will give you the city's blessing.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2533-3388-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
Repeat.

1636-3143-3190.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-3190.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Dragonspark Reactor trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Dragonspark Reactor trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5618.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or 2.
2034-5220-5618.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the extra nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the sacrificed creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top one or two cards of your library with the ability to cast them this turn.
Cast the creature from exile by paying at most {2}.
Repeat.

101-1987-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
101-1987-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Peregrine Drake.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
101-1987-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

requires.n: Artifact with MV<=2 that has a generic mana cost

413-1393-2364-4986--31.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Aether Channeler, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Aether Channeler trigger, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Aether Channeler, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Aether Channeler trigger, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-1409-4050-5383.notablePrerequisites: Cloudblazer is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1339-1409-4050-5383.description:
Activate Cloudblazer by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Cloudblazer enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloudblazer trigger, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Cloudblazer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Insects, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2612-3966.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Mirkwood Bats triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers for each opponent.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Mirkwood Bats triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers for each opponent.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all remaining Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain that much life, choosing not to pay for the Trudge Garden triggers in between.

507-5151.description:
Whenever a player casts a noncreature spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Deafening Silence prevents players from casting more than one noncreature spell each turn, players cannot cast a noncreature spell permitted by Possibility Storm, or any other noncreature spell that turn.

1636-2205.notablePrerequisites: Imperious Perfect does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2205.description:
Pay {G} and tap Imperious Perfect to create a 1/1 Elf.
The Elf enters untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
